challenge.headline: Modernizing Cultural Journalism for Next-Gen Digital Readers
challenge.description: Thelicham needed a modern digital transformation to present long-form essays, poetry, and cultural critiques with editorial beauty, dark/light reading modes, and seamless mobile responsiveness across diverse network conditions.
keyPoints: Designing an ultra-clean, distraction-free reading layout optimized for long-form literature.
Delivering fast dynamic routing for monthly issues, categories, and author archives.
Optimizing font rendering for complex script typography and multilingual accessibility.
Ensuring sub-second page loads even on low-bandwidth mobile networks.

architecture.headline: High-Performance Content Architecture & Edge Delivery
architecture.description: Built using Next for static page pre-rendering, paired with a headless content structure and edge CDN distribution for instant reading.

solution.headline: A Minimalist Editorial Sanctuary for Digital Readers
solution.description: Thelicham webzine merges traditional print publication aesthetics with modern web interactions, featuring custom font pairing, reading progress indicators, and issue archives.
